stem.en: What started the flood in Chamoli district in February 2021?

text.en: A long spell of heavy monsoon rain

feedback.en: February is not the monsoon season, and rain was not the start of this flood.

text.en: Rock and ice breaking off a ridge

feedback.en: Right. It fell and rushed down the valley with water and rock.

text.en: A moraine lake bursting its wall

feedback.en: Studies found no glacial lake burst in this flood.
The start was a fall of rock and ice from a high ridge.

explanation.en: A huge mass of rock and glacier ice broke off a high ridge above the Rishiganga valley. It fell and rushed downstream as a flood of ice, rock and water. Studies found no lake burst.

hints.en: Think about what was high above the valley.
